title: Doubao Work Reaches 8 Million DAU Three Months After Launch, Enterprise Customer ARR Exceeds RMB 2 Billion

content_html:
On November 18, Doubao officially announced that its productivity AI product "Doubao Work" had been live for only three months, with daily active users (DAU) surpassing 8 million and annual recurring revenue (ARR) from enterprise customers exceeding 2 billion yuan, demonstrating strong growth momentum in the commercialization of B2B AI applications.

Since its official release on August 25, Doubao Work has continued to deepen its focus on professional office scenarios. At the product feature level, the platform officially launched the "Workbench" feature on November 16, initially covering 21 vertical professional fields such as finance, healthcare, education, and creative design. By preconfiguring industry-specific skills and tools, it improves implementation efficiency, while also opening up permissions for creating, saving, and sharing custom Workbenches to strengthen collaboration and workflow within organizations.

In terms of the underlying model ecosystem, Doubao Work recently broke away from the single-model limitation and officially integrated mainstream third-party large models such as Kimi, GLM, and DeepSeek. It also clearly labels each model's quota consumption multiplier on the front end, supporting enterprise and individual users in autonomously scheduling according to specific task complexity and computing cost.

At the current industry inflection point, where competition in large models is shifting from a single technological contest to the implementation of high-frequency productivity scenarios, Doubao Work's combined strategy of "vertical-scenario Workbenches + free multi-model routing" effectively lowers the barrier to enterprise adoption and usage costs. This data performance not only confirms the actual willingness to pay for generative AI in the office field, but also provides an important reference sample for domestic AI-native applications exploring large-scale commercial closed loops.
